name: UI quality
usage: Add the devDependency "playwright" (pin an exact version) and the script "test:e2e": "node --test test/e2e/*.e2e.mjs"; CI runs npx playwright install chromium, then npm run test:e2e, and keeps e2e-report/ (a screenshot per width and main-journey-report.json, evidence e2e_report for SM-11-L1). Replace the demo page and steps in test/e2e/main-journey.e2e.mjs with the app's real main journey from its requirements file, using getByRole/getByLabel locators. runJourney fails a width on a step error, an uncaught page error, a console error, a page wider than the viewport, or a hang past timeoutMs, and always writes the report. Add e2e-report/ to .gitignore. Page error and console error text (up to 300 characters each) goes into the report, so the app never logs personal data or secrets to the browser console. Full tier (SM-11-F1/F2: every journey, axe, keyboard-only) is the app's own work.
